prompt_text: Who is the best dentist in Dallas for a dental implant?
ai_overview_text:
There is no single "best" dentist for a dental implant in Dallas, as the right specialist depends on whether you need a single tooth replacement, full-arch restoration, or specialized bone grafting. Dallas has several top-rated, specialized implant centers and periodontists:
Lead Specialist: Dr. David McFadden (board-certified prosthodontist) along with Dr. Daniel Tan and team.
Focus: Dedicated specialist practice focusing on complex implant cases and full restorations.
Reviews: 5.0/5.0 rating with nearly 600 reviews.
Website: The Dental Implant Center
Credentials: Look for a board-certified prosthodontist (specializes in the tooth replacement/crown part) or a periodontist / oral surgeon (specializes in the surgical bone and post placement).
Technology: Ensure they use 3D CBCT imaging for precision placement.
Consultations: Many local clinics (like ARCHPOINT or Smiley Dental) offer initial implant consultations to evaluate your bone density. dallasimplant.com +2
Are you replacing a single tooth or multiple teeth / full arch?
